terranima.name: Terrànima
terranima.description: Private portal for animal-care professionals and their clients.
terranima.overview: A private area for a family animal-care service. Families manage pets, appointments, documents and conversations with their team, and professionals (educators / nutritionists) handle assigned cases, schedule, docs and chats — including an internal team chat.

family.home: Home — greeting, active pet, next appointment, credits and shortcuts
family.animals: My pets — profiles (species, breed, weight, notes); tutor edits weight and notes
family.appointments: Appointments — upcoming / new; status flow; credit consumption
family.docs: Documents — file cabinet with search, filters and upload

pro.cases: Cases — assigned families, profiles, create/edit pets
pro.appointments: Appointments — pending / schedule / new; confirm or reject
pro.chats: Chats — with families + internal team chat

features.roles: Dual roles family / educator / nutritionist, with their own permissions
features.assignment: 1:1 assignment — each family has one educator and one nutritionist
features.animals: Pet profiles with photo and shared notes
features.agenda: Appointment schedule with states: pending → confirmed / rejected / cancelled / completed
features.credits: Session credits — packs (e.g. 8); consumed when booking, restored on cancel/reject
features.chats: Family↔professional chats + internal team chat, with unread counts
features.emergencies: Emergencies — urgent alerts from the family by email or WhatsApp

mentorix.name: Mentorix
mentorix.short: All-in-one toolkit to design, run and evaluate technical interviews with multi-LLM support, real-time voice, explainable rubrics and shareable candidate links.
mentorix.long: Mentorix lets recruiters define interview templates (role, seniority, rubric), generate a unique access link and have candidates complete guided interviews by text or voice. An LLM conducts the session, scores answers against weighted rubric dimensions and produces structured reports with strengths, gaps and a hiring recommendation.

agentic-code-reviewer.name: Agentic Code Reviewer
agentic-code-reviewer.short: Agentic system with planner, developer and QA/Security agents that propose code changes through reviewable pull requests.
agentic-code-reviewer.long: Agentic Code Reviewer coordinates several specialized agents: a planner that breaks down tasks, a developer that proposes code changes, and QA/Security agents that validate the solution. The system generates pull requests ready to be reviewed and manually approved in GitHub, integrating into a normal development workflow.

ftn.name: FTN
ftn.short: Domain‑specific language (DSL) designed to describe flows and automations in a declarative way.
ftn.long: FTN is a domain‑specific language (DSL) focused on describing integrations and workflows declaratively. It lets you define steps, conditions and side effects clearly, making it easier to automate repetitive processes, document integrations and reduce the complexity of imperative logic.
